youtube_channel: Филипп Романов астрономия Filipp Romanov astronomy
youtube_description:
Hello. My name is Filipp Romanov. I am twenty-one years old. I am amateur astronomer from Russia. I am discoverer of fifty four variable stars (without anyone's help) and my scientific paper about one of these stars was published in the scientific journal. I want to go to university and to study astronomy, but I am homeless for two years already. I want to be a scientist and to contribute to astronomy. I need your help! More information in the description:

I was born on April 27, 1997. My experience of astronomy is almost 10 years. I started to study astronomy by self-education in 2009 (since August 17, 2009; I was 12 years old).

I am discoverer of 54 variable stars and of 10 planetary nebulae candidates and 1 astronomical object of uncertain nature. List of my astronomical discoveries:   https://filipp-romanov.livejournal.com/27664.html   

My mother brought me up herself (alone). I was disabled for 10 years in orthopedics. I spent my childhood in hospitals. I have a lot of diseases (of joints, of bronchi, of blood and heart defect).

I had a dream to enter the Lomonosov Moscow State University to study astronomy and become an astronomer, so I came to Moscow from Primorsky Krai of the Russian Far East. My relatives together all bought me a small room (its area of 13.2 square meters) in a two-room communal apartment in Moscow.

I wanted to prepare there for the entrance exams to the University and I wanted live there while studying at the University. But on January 23, 2017 I lost the opportunity to live in my room, because in this communal apartment my rights were illegally violated.

I and my mother: were deprived of the opportunity to live safely and unhindered in this communal apartment, we lost the opportunity to take away our belongings and my telescopes from my room, and I lost the opportunity to sell my room. As a result, since January 23, 2017, I, my mother and our old cat Fanya (she is now 13 years old) - we are homeless.

My room is for sale since March 2017  https://www.avito.ru/moskva/komnaty/komnata_13.2_m_v_2-k_1214_et._1062043827  , but there are obstacles in its sale.

My life and my mother's life were in danger in this communal apartment, so we fleeing and we went wandering. For two years, my mother and I have been writing statements to the police, with video evidence of violations of our rights in this communal apartment, but no one helped us; I wrote to mayor of Moscow - Sergey Sobyanin and to President of Russia - Vladimir Putin, but probably, the officials did not give them my letters (my letters to the President of Russia and to the Mayor of Moscow were redirected by officials to other institutions of Moscow); and we are forced to wander for the third year, as homeless, about it I created my petition on December 09, 2017 on change.org: https://www.change.org/p/%D0%BF%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%B5-%D0%B2%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%BD%D1%83%D1%82%D1%8C-%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%8C%D0%B3%D0%B8-%D1%81%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8-%D0%B2-%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%BC%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%BB%D1%8C%D0%BD%D0%BE%D0%B9-%D0%BA%D0%B2%D0%B0%D1%80%D1%82%D0%B8%D1%80%D0%B5-%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%BF%D1%8F%D1%82%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B2%D1%83%D1%8E%D1%82-%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%B0%D0%B6%D0%B5-%D0%BC%D0%BE%D0%B5%D0%B9-%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%82%D1%8B

From Lomonosov Moscow State University, I received a letter that for the results of observations in astronomy, they do not accept students for education without passing entrance examinations. But I have no housing to study in it for exams, because I am homeless. And I have not only observations, but also scientific discoveries. From Saint Petersburg State University I also received a letter that they will not take me to study without passing entrance exams.

Now we are in Primorsky Krai of Russia. We do not have money for a lawyer/attorney to go to court, but I can not continue to be homeless with my many diseases. I really need help.

I have the opportunity to communicate with people (who will have the desire and opportunity to help me, my mother and our old cat) - on my pages on social networks:

https://www.facebook.com/romanov.philipp

https://twitter.com/romanov_filipp

https://www.instagram.com/romanov_filipp

https://filipp-romanov.livejournal.com/

There is a lot of detailed information about my life situation in my closed campaign on Indiegogo https://igg.me/at/amateur-astronomer , about which very few people knew, and therefore my campaign was not successful. I need help!
